en.t: As it turned out, there was more than one dog.
There seemed to be five or six of them.

units.source_text: 也许第一条狗的失败，把它们都给镇住了，

en.t: Perhaps the first dog's failure had intimidated them all,

units.source_text: 它们站得远远的，充满威胁地叫着，觊觎着空当。

en.t: for they stood at a distance, barking threateningly as they watched for an opening.

units.source_text: 先前在窝棚里看到的那条胖胖的红狗，像是在狗群后面煽动着。

en.t: The plump red dog he had seen earlier in the hut seemed to be egging them on from behind the pack.

units.source_text: 他以五十厘米左右的半径，旋转着手中的绳索，

en.t: He swung the rope in his hand in a circle about fifty centimeters in radius,

units.source_text: 以此为盾牌，一边左右牵制，一边越过空地上的贝壳山，

en.t: using it as a shield, checking them from side to side as he crossed the mound of shells in the open lot,

units.source_text: 在狭窄的粗垛墙之间穿梭奔跑，穿过铺着稻草的院子，

en.t: darting between the narrow rough earthen walls and running through a yard spread with straw,

units.source_text: 总算跑到宽阔的大道上来。

en.t: until at last he made it out onto the broad main road.

units.source_text: 快，再加一把劲，就能跑到村子外面了！

en.t: Hurry, one more push and he would be outside the village!
